output.explanation: Expanded data-core, the sole supplied diagram. Its central tree now follows frames down through GPU cells, snapshots, selection and search, while retaining text exports and host requests. Two adjacent peripherals elaborate terminal-state derivation and child I/O/session decisions; shared dependencies and feedback remain explicit references and edges. No diagrams were left unchanged, and there were no existing edges. Checked the pinned checkout without modifying it. Corrections include distinguishing PTY pixel extents from Terminal pixel dimensions, minimum-one-cell geometry, conditional primary-screen reflow, locked snapshot capture versus unlocked style resolution, read-only filtering by write route rather than origin, untrimmed raw text exports versus configured clipboard formatting, and ttyWrite being a completion callback. Added the existing Kitty paste-event path and clarified exit/confirmation precedence.

edges.label: Expands terminal state consumed by the snapshot
Expands child-bound bytes and session decisions
Shared font grid supplies shaping and glyph resources
Search navigation can move the viewport
Resolved local actions mutate terminal state
Exit fallback writes a terminal message
Backend stream belongs to the spawned session
Retained terminal state supplies response data
Geometry initializes the PTY and supplies size reports
Shared effective configuration supplies bindings and policies
